tool_schemas.name: use_description
tool_schemas.description: Returns service metadata records (service description/documentation) for the image generation service, optionally filtered by metadata_id and/or publication status. When metadata_id is omitted, we return all matching records as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if metadata_id does not match the required pattern or status is not one of {draft,published,archived}, and NOT_FOUND if a specific metadata_id is provided but no record exists.

metadata_id.description: Optional specific service_metadata record id to fetch.

status.description: Filter service metadata by publication status.

tool_schemas.name: generate_image
tool_schemas.description: Creates an image-generation job for the workspace identified by api_key and returns the created job record, including the resolved provider/model selection and the requested image count. If idempotency_key is provided, repeated submissions with the same api_key and idempotency_key return the original job instead of creating a duplicate. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or invalid (including requested_image_count < 1 or provider not in the allowed enum), and CONFLICT when the request attempts an unsupported provider/model selection for the workspace configuration.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace for this generation request.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to deduplicate repeated submissions.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Optional text describing what to avoid in the generated image.

model.description: Model identifier to use for generation; defaults to the workspace's default_model when omitted.

provider.description: Provider backend to use for generation.

request_params.description: Provider/model-specific parameters (e.g., size, steps, guidance, style) passed through to the backend.

requested_image_count.description: Number of images requested for this job.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns information about the caller associated with the provided api_key, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes, and current month-to-date quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid api_key and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller.

tool_schemas.name: list_image_generation_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists image-generation jobs visible to the workspace identified by api_key, with optional filtering by status and time range. Returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid api_key and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace.

created_after.description: Only include jobs created at or after this timestamp (RFC3339).

created_before.description: Only include jobs created before this timestamp (RFC3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_image_generation_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single image-generation job by id for the workspace identified by api_key. Returns the job record, including resolved provider/model and billing fields when present. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist in the caller workspace, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid api_key, and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace.

job_id.description: Image generation job id to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_image_generation_job
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or running image-generation job. On success, transitions the job to status=cancelled and sets finished_at. Refuses CONFLICT if the job is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled) and NOT_FOUND if the job is not visible to the caller workspace.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace.

job_id.description: Image generation job id to cancel.

reason.description: Optional client-provided reason for cancellation (stored for audit/diagnostics when supported).

tool_schemas.name: list_generated_images
tool_schemas.description: Lists generated image outputs for the workspace identified by api_key, optionally filtered by job_id and status. Returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid api_key and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace.

job_id.description: If provided, only return images produced by this job.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: delete_generated_image
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a generated image output by transitioning its status from stored to deleted. Does not remove the parent job record; physical deletion is handled asynchronously by storage backend policies. Refuses CONFLICT if the image is already deleted and NOT_FOUND if the image does not exist in the caller workspace.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate and identify the workspace.

metadata.name: AI Image Generation Service
metadata.description: This backend stores tenants (workspaces), API credentials, and image generation jobs with their produced images. Main workflows: a client uses an API key to submit an image generation request (job), the system executes it against a configured model/provider, stores outputs, and exposes service metad
